notes.note_content:
MIG SAN - Miguel Sandoval: MIG SAN rhythm monitoring reviewed.


Predominant sinus rhythm with multiple episodes of non-sustained ventricular tachycardia, as well as episodes of atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response and SVT with rapid ventricular response. The ventricular tachycardia is quite convincing, with the longest episode lasting eight beats.


Clinical correlation is necessary.
